about_the_game:
PROJECT: FIRMAMENT is a top-down shooter where you play as a task force undergoing missions for their elusive boss to aid her attempt to cheat the universe's expiration date. Swarms of the scriptural King's influenced close in from all corners of the lone planet to halt your progress.

Instead of a traditional run-and-gun system, PROJECT: FIRMAMENT utilizes a unique lock-on system that factors in aiming time, ending lag, and several additional factors to make the gunplay based on map knowledge, quick positioning, and remaining intimate with your weapons' specialties.


As combat rages on, the cosmic blood underneath the planet's crust will reach out. Connect it to fallen foes' corpses and reap huge rewards once enough have been absorbed!!

With an assortment of 40+ past, present, and future missions; three playable characters that have nine levels of unlockable perks; handfuls of unique throwable items; and customizable enemy difficulty additions, PROJECT: FIRMAMENT seeks to bring replayable, high-octane gameplay where your success lies on thoughtful preparation and swift thinking!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mentions of alcohol, drugs, and brief sexual innuendos. There are fantasy depictions of gore.
